identificationModule.briefTitle: Synthetic Study of Therapy A for Advanced Lung Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This randomized study compares investigational Therapy A with standard chemotherapy in adults with advanced non-small cell lung cancer.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: The study measures progression-free survival and records adverse events during treatment.

interventions.name: Therapy A
interventions.description: Therapy A is given by intravenous infusion every 3 weeks for up to 6 cycles.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria: Adults with confirmed advanced non-small cell lung cancer and measurable disease may be considered. Additional criteria apply.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This observational study examines how daily activity and blood pressure relate to heart health over time.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Participants complete health questionnaires, wear an activity monitor for 7 days, and have blood pressure measured at a study visit. No treatment is assigned by the study.

eligibilityModule.studyPopulation: Adults previously seen in participating primary care clinics.

identificationModule.briefTitle: Synthetic Study With Limited Public Details
